method: Independent model linguistic review of all 500 roots, read sequentially in ten manageable batches with every retained English meaning and Spanish semantic evidence. Each approval selects one exact zero-based English meaning index and its record hash, an original source-grounded English predicate, a supported subject profile, and a bounded imperfect/aspect reading. This is not source-membership-only approval, native-human certification, or a claim of rendered translation coverage. Rare, archaic, regional and technical senses are eligible with retained source-specific caveats. Literal nonhuman-only subjects are restricted to the safe it subset; human operators, human biological actions, human-compatible musical/figurative senses and animal/plant patients are not automatically restricted. Mandatory pronominal roots, unsupported construction changes, intervening-patient frames, first-head compound inflection risks and unreliable lexical alignments are withheld. Ordinary context-supplied trailing complements are allowed as grammatical fragments, not complete example sentences. Explicit generic patients already present in source glosses are not invented referents. No past/participle overrides are supplied; existing verified AGID sense/paradigm, source grammar and subject/aspect gates remain mandatory. No app files changed.
